items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Reads the framework-owned model config, shows all four requested roles, and adds only opt-in start overrides.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Missing, malformed, and invalid config states fail soft to inherited tiers; unavailable projects receive existing-style 404/400 JSON errors.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The route defines GET only, uses project registry lookup, returns no raw configuration content, and has no config write path.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Reader, router, API-contract, UI, action-schema, and real-browser tests assert observable behavior including the read-only invariant.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: React Query deduplicates per-project reads; the small config is read only on the API request path and has no list-wide server scan.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New concern-specific files are below 300 LOC and reuse the existing run-config router, action-schema, and query conventions.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: The E2E fixture writes shipwright_model_config.json, then verifies reader/API/card/start-dialog behavior through the running stack.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: The changed test files add no focused or silently skipped tests; the mandatory diff probe is run again in F0.5.
